script: Spread and total were not saved for GB at TB, so this is form-only. TB's offense is Bucky Irving (40 carries, 180 rush yards, 4.5 YPC, 15 targets) ahead of Baker Mayfield (-0.26 EPA vs blitz, -0.25 without), while GB has not run on anybody (Marshawn Lloyd 23 carries, 68 yards, 2.96 YPC) and has lived on Matthew Golden (30 targets, 253 yards, 416 air) and Christian Watson (29 targets, 284 yards, 304 air). GB should be forced into dropbacks that TB will heat at a 46% blitz, and TB should lean on Irving because GB allows 4.34 YPC and 8 runs of 10+ but only 5 passes of 20+ yards on 98 attempts.
who_goes_off: For TB, Bucky Irving should go off: 180 rush yards plus 61 receiving over three games into a GB defense allowing 4.34 YPC. TB tight end Cade Otton (17 targets, 120 yards, 138 air yards) is the pass answer into GB's middle at 8.77 YPA. GB's raw heaters are Matthew Golden (84.3 rec yds/game) and Christian Watson (94.7), but those air-yard profiles run at TB's tighter edges (left 6.57 YPA, right 6.36), not TB's middle.
weak_spot: TB's real leak is the middle, 9.47 YPA on 17 attempts versus 6.57 left (44 att) and 6.36 right (33 att), with the run held to 3.30 YPC and only 6 runs of 10+, so GB's matchup is TB linebackers, nickel, and safeties, not TB outside corners. GB's leak is the same middle lane at 8.77 YPA on 13 attempts plus the ground game at 4.34 YPC and 8 runs of 10+; GB's right side is the strength at 6.63 YPA on 41 attempts.
injury_fallout: No injury report was saved for GB at TB, so no fallout is applied to either roster. TB usage stays Irving 40 carries to Kenny Gainwell's 10; GB stays a committee of Marshawn Lloyd 23, Kaleb Johnson 12, and Chris Brooks 11.
qb_vs_blitz: GB quarterback Jordan Love is -0.28 EPA/dropback vs blitz (n=58) and +0.19 with no blitz, and TB blitzes 46%, so GB timing to Golden and Watson is the stressed piece. TB quarterback Baker Mayfield is -0.26 vs blitz (n=43) and -0.25 without, and GB blitzes only 35%, so the blitz toggle does not flip TB — Irving, Otton, and Chris Godwin Jr. (11 targets, 52 air yards) stay the stable TB answers.

picks.why: TB's Bucky Irving is at 80.3 rush+rec yards per game (180 rush + 61 rec) against a 72 line, with 40 carries at 4.5 YPC into a GB defense allowing 4.34 YPC and 8 runs of 10+, plus 15 targets at -33 air yards that fit a GB unit allowing only 5 explosives on 98 attempts.

TB's Cade Otton has 120 yards on 17 targets over three games (40.0 per game) versus a 25.5 line, with 138 air yards aimed at the middle where GB allows 8.77 YPA on 13 attempts, and TB's Mayfield stays at -0.25 EPA even when GB blitzes only 35%.
